observed.source: Codex session rollout (CLI-recorded thread settings; not model-authored)

result.decision_rationale: Both pending defects are fixed. The generic plan now enforces the project’s required gates on the reviewed commit, and preflight uses the same developer model check as report admission. The candidate-bound behavior suite covers WF04–WF10 and WF12. The evidence supports advancement to setup-final.

executed_verification: Verified the detached HEAD, merge base and mission digest. The supplied 11,779-line feature diff matched the Git comparison. All three gate log hashes matched their receipts for H.

The controller’s unit gate ran 191 tests with one live test skipped. The passing cases included failed-gate admission, missing and stale receipts, conflicting transcript models, publication reconciliation, stop/resume, archive checks and intermediate advancement.

The permissions gate recorded two real Claude launches. The isolated launch denied the user-level status command and ran the enrolled helper and Git inspection command. The control launch ran the user-level command.

The separate live-smoke gate recorded a real Opus/high developer and Astra reviewer completing a fixture handoff. The developer pushed fixture commit 37469d0, ran its unit gate and received a passing receipt for that commit.
inspected: The fixed comparison, mission and owner addenda, repository instructions, protocol, developer report, prior findings ledger and controller-owned gate evidence.

The controller’s candidate capture, model checks, review validation, publication, locking, budget, stop/resume and archive paths, together with the schemas, prompts, project gate declarations and behavior tests.
limitations: The review used the controller’s recorded runs. The read-only snapshot precluded a local gate rerun, and the foreground transcript index points to the receipts because the session also contained unrelated work.
The live smoke used simulated GitHub. Publication and handoff on a real unattended draft PR remain part of setup-final.
source_inspection_only: For R11-F1, the new regression used a fixture plan with the same gate omission as the shipped single plan. Source inspection confirmed that the shipped plan, developer prompt, review acceptance and final handoff use the resolved project requirements.

For R11-F2, the regression exercised the shared predicate with consistent and conflicting models. Source inspection confirmed that preflight records the transcript models, uses that predicate for its developer verdict and returns a blocked CLI status when the verdict fails. The recorded tests did not invoke the full preflight command with a conflicting transcript.

prior_finding_assessments.rationale: The controller combines project-required gates with checkpoint additions. Development-process requires only unit, so omitting gates from the single plan preserves that requirement and leaves both supplemental gates optional. A temporary-repository regression ran a failing unit gate and observed report rejection. Companion receipt tests covered missing, passing and stale receipts.

Preflight now retains invocation-local transcript models and checks them alongside the stream’s initial and main-thread models. The shared predicate accepted consistent Opus observations and rejected an Opus stream paired with a Sonnet transcript observation. The production admission test also observed rejection of that conflict.

summary.delivered_behavior: The controller binds validation and independent review to a committed candidate, preserves unresolved findings across rounds and advances a clean intermediate checkpoint automatically.
pending_later_phase_work: Complete the unattended demonstration on an authorized real draft PR, including candidate validation, review publication, continuation and final handoff.
Complete the setup acceptance report, installation and operating documentation, effective permissions record, and Black Tentacles binding with its exact start command.
remaining_owner_review: Review the completed setup and real pilot evidence at the final checkpoint, then decide whether to adopt the reviewed version.
summary.scope_reviewed: Controller-core under the supported first-release conditions of one controller, one developer, sequential validation and review, and fixed controller and project configuration.
